notes.title: ENDLESS MODE IS COMING!
notes.notes:
Now endless mode is coming!
We have made a brand new endless mode for the hard core player. If you would like to challenge yourself you can try it out. In the mode:
1.	Endless waves of monsters are coming.
2.	You can place the toys with an amount limit, which is only 25.
3.	You can defense the enemies by attacking the clouds in the sky using skills.

Further works:
1.	Toys can upgrade, each one has 3 levels.
2.	Monsters will get stronger in the high level waves.
3.	You can see the rank list all over the world.

notes.title: Update for Spring Festival
notes.notes:
Hey foks!

Spring Festival is coming and we will ship a new update very soon:

- Decreasing difficulty for the first four levels of area 1. (It's just too darn hard)

- Lucky Stars. These will fall from the sky and if you catch (shoot) them in time, they'll award you short bonuses to help you pass the level. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164784/48ceee8ac1140a3074af9620496003bfeae3dac1.jpg[/img]

- Change the toy summoning system. It's hard to put into words exactly how this will change, but the intention is to make monster summoning more easily accessible. 

- Introducing the Nurse toy. She can heal your other toys, which should be a big help for the more difficult levels. "Helloooo Nurse!"
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164784/80ca159b3eb590a3ed325c2a62471b64a724e178.jpg[/img]

- Introducing a weather system. While we're already quite proud of our levels and environments, we want to take things up a notch and put weather effects. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164784/3615441f00c1597f5212624655c23139ae31b3ba.jpg[/img]

The team is planning to release this update within the next few weeks. After that point, we'll have a new list of incoming changes, one of which being a "Children's Mode" that greatly reduces the difficulty of the game, allowing children to play without the pressure of being overwhelmed by monsters. 

As always, thanks for your interest in the game and hope you enjoy the Spring Festival!

notes.title: First update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
The first update of Child Of Ault is coming soon! This time we are focused on improvement of tutorial instructions, special ammo usage, toys AI, and so on. We also bring trading cards in this update.

1.	Improved tutorial instructions.

2.	Quality of life improvements to the first chapter (Spring chapter), including monster spawn behavior adjustments and significant changes to the boss battle.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164784/cde7f58d7e41109e5940b6615c550588147f4efb.jpg[/img]

3.	Improved special ammo usage, namely that if you press fire ammo and shoot it, your ammo will go back to default ammo after that shot. This will help the player conserve energy by not automatically consuming all of your energy on special ammo. This will also encourage the player to quickly switch between special and normal ammo, and develop a kind of rhythm-like strategy. 

4.	Improved toy AI and HP boosts. We've adjusted the toys so that they no longer march to their deaths at the purple enemy crystal. The team is still figuring out what they want to do with that enemy crystal, but having your toys walk up to it and die was frustrating for the player. 
Now the toys will stay within close range of their original placement, allowing for more tower defense-like strategy.  

5.	Levels will have bombs that players can shoot at to cause massive damage to surrounding enemies. These are a one-time use item, so use them wisely, for example when a large wave of monsters is about to overwhelm that area, send them a nice warm greeting. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164784/c4c9571e57cf81268e7f8caa8920f5ac75757f1a.png[/img]

6.	Added 5 trading cards:

notes.title: Finally!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

I’m Luoya, the game producer of Child Of Ault. We here at NezhaGames are very happy to ship our game today! 

About half a year ago, we discovered a passion for shooter and tower defence games after our team got the chance to play with a real life longbow. We enjoyed the longbow so much that we wanted to make a game that embodied the spirit of using actually using one. 
Thankfully, this newfound passion coincided with the release of VR into the wilds of the gaming scene. So, we figured, what better way to capture the joy of shooting stuff with sharp objects than with a full VR experience? 

And so "Child of Ault" was born.

In COA, players can arrange their own defensive formations a-la tower defense, while using their longbow to take out monsters a-la shooter. We're really trying to give players a sense of chaotic FPS action, mixed with the strategy of tower defense. But… we're not done, yet. There's still plenty to come.

Currently, we have a strong framework for the game. There are already 14 unique levels, each level introducing a new monster type, and finishing with a BOSS battle.

Still, there is much left to do, as what the game is so far, is only a part of the completed game,
During the next six months, we will continue to improve the game, working on balancing, bugs, and additional features.  

Finally, if you have any good suggestions, ideas, or general feedback, please feel free to contact me, as we welcome the input. 

Please refer to the information on our Company's homepage: www.nezhagames.com.
